claim: JNext clears key presses made before a .nex finishes loading; schedule keys after the load and confirm from the game's own state that they arrived.

evidence.text: JNext clears keys held before NEX load, so keys start at frame 501 after load 500; otherwise moving/fire runs can describe neutral-input play.
evidence.quote: JNext clears keys held before NEX load, so keys start at frame 501 after load 500;
